thought.text: I've realized I misunderstood the fundamental issue here. The architecture says the Identity is not about how the user identifies themselves but rather about how the AI itself identifies.  Let me create a clean application layer between GUI and core:

action.old_str:
"""
Lyra 0.0.1 - Core Domain Package
"""

# This package contains the core application state and domain logic
# that implements Lyra's architectural boundaries:
# - AI Instance State (Identity, Personality, Memory) 
# - Brain (Coordination system)
# - Model capabilities
# - Persistence mechanisms

__version__ = "0.0.1"
action.new_str:
"""
Lyra 0.0.1 - Core Domain Package
"""

__all__ = ['AIInstance']
